positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description: Developer on the Platform and Infrastructure team at OSIsoft/Aveva.

positions.title: ITS Student Help Desk Technician
positions.description: Acted as first point of contact for technical support at the University of San Francisco.  Discovered and resolved surplus of software and hardware issues to entire student body and faculty.  Daily tasks included logging and tracking issues within Service-Now ticketing system and providing assistance to clients via email, phone and over the counter via walk-ins.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
Intern on the OSIsoft Cloud Services - Identity Services Team.

Experience working with Cloud Based Technology such as Microsoft Azure, Service Fabric, ASP .NET Core, Microsoft Graph APIs, and Azure DevOps.  Summer role consisted of implementing public and private API's in C#, while working in an Agile Scrum Environment.

positions.title: Computer Science Course Instructor
positions.description: Instructed 30+ students ages 6-10 on basic coding concepts such as for-loops, functions, and variables.  By the end of each week, students projects resulted in new programs implemented on Sphero to control the Sphero BOLT robot and presented to parents and faculty.
